plain: The person in a court case who is accused or sued

more.text: In law, the party that opposes a complaint, demand or charge; he that is summoned into court, and defends, denies or opposes the demand or charge, and maintains his own right.

example.quote: In all such cases the state is plaintiff, and the person accused is defendant.
example.cite: Letters of Agrippa I-XI, Massachusetts Gazette, Nov. 1787-Jan. 1788
